Four date functions for month-end-safe date math.

- `add_months_iso(date, n)`: months later or earlier; a day the target month doesn't have becomes its last day (2026-01-31 + 1 month = 2026-02-28)
- `months_between(a, b)`: whole months, counted the way `add_months_iso` steps, so the two always agree
- `age_in_years(birth_date, as_of)`: age in whole years on a date
- `start_of_week(date, first_day)`: the first day of a week starting on any weekday

65 functions in all. Every test case passes with the Rhai engine on GitHub and in a Neblex Code step.
